2438-7084-8337.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, M'Ress triggers, creating two 1/1 red Officer creature tokens
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

4881-6909-7202.manaNeeded: {3}{R} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
4881-6909-7202.description:
Cast Kindle the Inner Flame by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

1981-2415-6794-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

586-864-3125-6351-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-6351-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Teval.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token
Repeat.

3115-3557-4823.description:
Cast Cyclonic Rift for its overload cost by paying {6}{U}, returning all nonland permanents you don't control to their owners' hands.
Deal combat damage using Brago, triggering its ability, blinking Timeless Witness.
When Timeless Witness enters, it triggers, returning Cyclonic Rift from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1991-3259-4460.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1991-3259-4460.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Tana, triggering Breath of Fury and Tana.
Resolve the Tana trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1591-2459-4336-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1591-2459-4336-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

3263-5641-6830-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3263-5641-6830-6996.description:
Gain life in any way.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

876-4360-7070.description:
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Greenweaver Druid.
Monk Gyatso triggers. Choose not to airbend Greenweaver Druid.
Resolve Lightning Greaves' ability, attaching it to Greenweaver Druid.
Activate Greenweaver Druid by tapping it, adding {G}{G}
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Monk Gyatso.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, targeting Greenweaver Druid.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Greenweaver Druid.
The Lightning Greaves ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Greenweaver Druid from exile by paying {2}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

3099-3921-4762-7741.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Winding Constrictor and Shang-Chi.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 6 or greater

7308-7500.description:
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least six mana of any color
Activate Ringing Strike Mastery by paying {5}, untapping Mona Lisa.
Repeat.

465-2034-3175.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Sun Titan from exile to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Sun Titan.
Repeat from step 3.

1594-4771-5660.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it, targeting Evolution Witness, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Myr Scrapling from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying {0}.
Repeat.

3532-3581-5078-6822.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Kykar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

662-1978-5168.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three colors among permanents you control.
662-1978-5168.description:
Cause Bloom Tender to become an artifact using Liquimetal Coating.
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Bloom Tender.
Repeat from step 2.

1462-2034-2059-4679.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Village Bell-Ringer.
When the Village Bell-Ringer token enters, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Village Bell-Ringer token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent

5276-5332-6524-6798.description:
Cast All-Out Assault by paying {2}{R}{W}{B}.
When All-Out Assault enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Move to your extra combat phase. All-Out Assault triggers, untapping each creature you control.
Declare Carmen as an attacker, triggering its second ability, returning Leonin Relic-Warder form your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling All-Out Assault.
Move to your postcombat main phase, and activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability and Carmen's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Carmen trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Leonin Relic-Warder trigger, returning All-Out Assault from exile to the battlefield.
When All-Out Assault enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

997-1077-5434-5555.notablePrerequisites:
You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
You have enough mana to cast Wrong Turn.
997-1077-5434-5555.description:
Cast Wrong Turn by paying its mana cost, giving control of Karlov Watchdog to an opponent.
During the opponent's turn, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1247-5536-5724.notablePrerequisites:
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Sage of the Maze and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
1247-5536-5724.description:
Activate Rex using Sage of the Maze's ability by tapping it, adding two mana of any color(s).
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

2556-4377-5626.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U} the first turn, with {6}{U}{U}{B}{B} each extra turn
2556-4377-5626.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.
You have at least {E}{E}.
2556-4377-5626.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Mnemonic Wall from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}, sacrificing Mnemonic Wall, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

731-5280-5919.manaNeeded: {4}{U}{U} if each opponent has three or more poison counters, or {6}{U}{U}{U} otherwise
731-5280-5919.notablePrerequisites: Corrupted Conscience attached to Razorkin Needlehead.
731-5280-5919.description:
Cast Echo of Eons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing each player to discard their hands and draw seven cards.
Razorkin Needlehead triggers for each card your opponents draw.
Resolve the first trigger, causing the opponent to get a poison counter.
If the opponent has ten or more poison counters, they lose the game as a state-based action.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining trigger.
If needed, cast Echo of Eons from your graveyard for its flashback cost by paying {2}{U}, causing each player to discard their hands and draw seven cards.
Repeat from step 2.

2281-2438-2757-5006.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one basic Forest.
You control at least one basic Plains.
2281-2438-2757-5006.description:
Activate a basic Forest and Plains by tapping them, adding {G}{W}.
Activate Earthcraft twice by tapping Lurrus and Saffi, untapping the basic Forest and Plains.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Lurrus.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Lurrus.
When Lurrus dies, Saffi triggers, returning Lurrus from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Saffi from your graveyard by paying {G}{W}.
Repeat.

235-386-4150.description:
Cast Shivan Meteor by paying {3}{R}{R}, dealing 13 damage to any creature.
Imodane triggers, giving each opponent thirteen poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.

1558-1692-3263-4690.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least four basic lands.
Helm of the Host attached to Phylath.
1558-1692-3263-4690.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Phylath with haste.
When the Phylath token enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating at least four 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing the Phylath token and the Plant tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2136-2567-4688.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least four lands.
2136-2567-4688.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Avenger of Zendikar.
When the Avenger of Zendikar tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, creating at least twenty 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
At the beginning of your end step, Orthion triggers, causing you to sacrfiice the Avenger of Zendikar tokens.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Epic Struggle triggers, causing you to win the game.

914-2750-4331.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least eight artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-2750-4331.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least eight Treasure tokens.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{U}{U}{R}.
Activate Memnarch's first ability by paying {1}{U}{U}, causing Dockside Extortionist to become an artifact.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2228-2842-4279.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
2228-2842-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
2228-2842-4279.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

2505-2713-4499-5313.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {1}, blinking Thragtusk.
Thragtusk enters and leaves the battlefield, triggering its abilities.
Resolve the Thragtusk enters-the-battlefield trigger, causing you to gain five life.
Resolve the Thragtusk leaves-the-battlefield trigger, creating a 3/3 Beast creature token.
Activate Treasonous Ogre by paying three life, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1368-2706-3518.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six other cards in hand and/or graveyard.
1368-2706-3518.description:
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by discarding your hand and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Cast Wheel of Fortune from your graveyard for its escape cost by paying {2}{R} and exiling 3 cards from your graveyard.
Resolve Wheel of Fortune, causing each player to discard their hand and draw seven cards.
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard for its escape cost by exiling 3 cards from your graveyard.
 Repeat.

2174-3573-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Juniper Order Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Juniper Order Druid.
You control at least two artifacts.
2174-3573-4222.description:
Activate Tolarian Academy by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Tolarian Academy.
Activate Freed from the Real's last ability by paying {U}, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Repeat any number of times.

2713-4289-4449.notablePrerequisites: Hateflayer does not have summoning sickness.
2713-4289-4449.description:
Activate Hateflayer by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Hateflayer by paying {R} and untapping it, causing it to deal damage equal to its power to any target.
Repeat.
